description: Reviewed SHA-256 pin of the Provider 06 protected runtime and schema files. A change to any protected byte must update this manifest in the same PR (an explicit re-attestation) and regenerate the conformance artifact. Each re-pin lists the paths that diverge from upstreamBaseCommit and why; the Provider 06 partner is informed of every re-pin.

repins.reason: ruff format (no behavior change) for both files; mock_endpoint.py also defines its module logger before the test-key-pair ImportError fallback that logs, fixing a NameError on that path.

Phase 2 sidecar contract alignment: add POST /v1/verify-release over UDS/HTTP, HMAC-SHA256 request authentication, mandatory FileJWKSClient receipt verification, signed refusal preservation (REVIEW, BLOCKED, RELEASE_REFUSED), non-200 technical failure handling, and exact returned-byte dispatch.
Enforce strict_v2=True on verify_receipt_digest and verify_receipt_signature in _verify_v1_receipt so POST /v1/verify-release rejects legacy Phase 1 unsigned-body receipt signatures.

Rebase the narrow verify-release Content-Type and client/timestamp/signature wire-header corrections onto PR #481 while preserving its strict_v2 receipt digest/signature validation. HMAC framing, public schemas, trust anchors, legacy headers and dispatch behavior are unchanged. This re-attestation does not establish full adapter admission or deployment readiness.
